title: The Storm Rises Again
next_chapter_hook: "The mystery of the dragon veins in the imperial letter, what connection does it have with father's relics? In those blurred foresight visions, my sister Chen Nian's figure appears faintly—the chessboard of fate is quietly turning."

text.content: "An ancient jade pendant fell into his palm, and a desolate yet familiar fluctuation instantly pierced through his soul—Chen Ji raised his head sharply, pupils contracting: this was his father's aura! How could he have something of his father's? The moment his fingertips touched the warm surface of the jade pendant, long-sealed memories surged forth like a tide. 'Father...' he murmured, throat choked. The patterns on that jade pendant were identical to those on the pendant his father wore at his waist in memory. Yet, how could a servant disciple suddenly receive such a relic? Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly, alarm bells ringing in his heart—was this coincidence, or the beginning of a larger chess game?"

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji! Are you spacing out here again?" Su Qingyao's cold voice came from behind, footsteps approaching, "The Sect Competition ended three days ago, what are you still doing in the scripture archive? Everyone's waiting at the celebration banquet, don't think getting first place lets you put on airs."

text.content: "Chen Ji quickly tucked the jade pendant into his sleeve, turning around with his usual timid expression already in place. He bowed respectfully, his voice weak: 'Senior Sister Su, please don't blame me, I was merely organizing what I gained from the competition and got lost in thought.' Saying this, he raised his head, a pair of clear eyes with timidity gazing at Su Qingyao, 'The celebration banquet... I naturally must attend.' In his heart, however, he was rapidly calculating: this jade pendant came from somewhere suspicious, who could have sent it to him? Su Qingyao's gaze lingered on him for a moment, seeming to notice something, yet quickly looking away. 'Let's go,' she turned, 'what's the holdup.'"

dialogue.content: "Brother!" A clear voice suddenly rang out, Chen Nian rushing out from the celebration banquet hall and throwing her arms around Chen Ji's arm, "You're finally here! I was so bored to death, those senior brothers keep talking about boring topics, like cultivation realms and technique secrets..." She chattered away, completely oblivious to Su Qingyao's increasingly icy gaze behind her."

text.content: "Su Qingyao stared at Chen Nian holding Chen Ji's arm, her brow center twitching slightly. What was wrong with this girl? During the Sect Competition, hadn't she declared she would remove this scourge for the Tianqing Sect, beating this废物 senior brother back to his true form? How just a few days later, had she become so intimate? She cleared her throat coldly: 'Chen Shimei is truly in high spirits. Where is that fierce momentum from the competition? How come now she acts like a clingy little beast.' Chen Nian turned her head upon hearing this, blinking innocently: 'Senior Sister Su, what are you talking about? When did I say I would remove a scourge? I was... I was cheering for my brother!'"

dialogue.content: "Cheering?" Su Qingyao's voice suddenly rose, drawing glances from several disciples nearby. She took a deep breath, maintaining the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow's dignity: 'Chen Nian, what are you calling me? Senior Sister? Since when are we so familiar?' Chen Nian tilted her head, seriously saying: 'But you are clearly senior sister? Should I call you Su Senior Fellow? That would be too formal!' She turned to look at Chen Ji, 'Brother, right? Senior Sister Su is very kind, she often secretly gives me spirit fruits to eat!' Su Qingyao's face instantly flushed red—when did she ever secretly give any! This girl was clearly talking nonsense!"

text.content: "Chen Ji watched Su Qingyao's almost-exploding appearance, secretly laughing in his heart. This girl was quite something, cooperating perfectly. He stepped forward, softly saying: 'Young sister Qingyao is young and doesn't understand the rules, her rudeness should be pardoned.' As he spoke, he subtly pinched Chen Nian's hand, signaling her to stop. Su Qingyao coldly snorted: 'No need.' She stared at Chen Ji's calm face, feeling something was off, 'Rather, you stayed in the scripture archive for three days, what exactly were you looking for?'"

dialogue.content: "Reporting to Senior Sister, I merely wanted to read more classics to broaden my horizons.' Chen Ji lowered his eyes, 'Since I won first place by chance in the competition, if I don't seize the opportunity to consolidate my foundation, I fear I will disappoint the sect's expectations.' Su Qingyao looked him over, suddenly smiling—that smile carried a hint of mockery, 'Consolidate your foundation? You, a servant who hasn't even broken through Foundation Building, what foundation are you consolidating? Do you expect to ascend to immortality overnight?' The surrounding disciples broke into whispered laughter. Chen Ji remained expressionless, merely nodding slightly: 'Senior Sister's教训 is correct.'"

text.content: "Just then, an uproar came from inside the celebration banquet hall. A plump figure stumbled out, it was the Outer Disciple Manager, Fatty Qian. Sweating profusely, he waved a letter in his hand: 'Chen Ji! Where are you? Someone sent you a letter, they want you to open it personally!' Chen Ji frowned slightly, stepping forward to take the envelope. There was no sender's name on the cover, only a strange seal—a coiling dragon shape, emanating faint imperial aura. Fatty Qian leaned in close, lowering his voice: 'The messenger's cultivation is unfathomable, they dropped the letter and vanished. Their background... is likely not small.'"

choice.prompt: "The imperial letter arrived suddenly, should you open it in front of everyone or privately?"

choices.description: "Open the letter publicly before everyone, displaying the '废物's openness, and see if there's usable information."
choices.visible_reward: "Let all disciples witness the mysterious letter, raise reputation"
choices.risk_hint: "If the letter contains sensitive information, it may attract unnecessary attention"

text.content: "Chen Ji opened the envelope before everyone, his movements calm and unhurried. Su Qingyao frowned, approaching to glance at the letter's contents—her expression suddenly changed slightly. The letter contained only a few words: 'Heavenly Secrets Pavilion Master, your presence is requested. The dragon veins will stir. North of the imperial capital, atop the clouds.' The signature was a vermillion seal symbolizing the imperial secret archive."

choices.description: "Take the letter on grounds of privacy, open it when alone. Maintain the usual low-profile persona."
choices.visible_cost: "Appear secretive, may arouse Su Qingyao's suspicion"
choices.visible_reward: "Control the information alone, avoid alerting the enemy"
choices.risk_hint: "Su Qingyao's curiosity will only grow stronger, making future questioning more troublesome"

text.content: "Chen Ji tucked the letter into his sleeve, nodding thanks to Fatty Qian: 'Thank you, Manager, for delivering this. I'll keep it for now.' Su Qingyao's gaze was like a blade fixed on his sleeve, her tone playful: 'What, afraid we'll see it? Chen Ji, you are becoming more and more interesting.' She didn't press further, but that cold smile at the corner of her mouth made Chen Ji secretly vigilant. This Inner Disciple Senior Fellow would surely start investigating again."

"Chen Ji tucked the letter close to his body, turning to bow to the crowd: 'Fellow senior brothers and sisters, I still have some matters to attend to, so I won't disturb the celebration banquet.' Fatty Qian hastily waved his hand: 'No problem, no problem, Chen Shixiong go ahead.' However, Su Qingyao blocked his path, her phoenix eyes cold as frost: 'Dragon veins? Imperial secret archive? When did a servant disciple like you get involved with such lofty connections?' She lowered her voice, 'Chen Ji, you better give me an explanation.' Chen Nian, seeing things going wrong, quickly grabbed her brother's sleeve, looking nervously at Su Qingyao."

dialogue.content: "Senior Sister Su, why do you always target my brother?" Chen Nian puffed her cheeks, looking unconvinced, 'What did he do to you? Or are you jealous that he's good-looking?' Su Qingyao froze for a moment, then laughed despite her anger: 'Jealous of him? Jealous of a废物?' She pointed at Chen Ji's nose, 'Look at his timid demeanor, what about him deserves my jealousy?' Chen Nian didn't back down: 'But brother got first place in the competition! If you're so great, you go get one too!' The surrounding disciples burst into laughter. Su Qingyao's face was livid, yet she had no comeback—she hadn't participated in the competition."

choice.prompt: "Your sister publicly retorted Su Qingyao, the situation deadlocked, how to resolve it?"

choices.description: "Stand with Chen Nian, directly counter Su Qingyao's questioning, defend your sister."
choices.visible_cost: "Completely offend Su Qingyao, future troubles will follow"
choices.visible_reward: "Show a protective image in front of all disciples, increase Chen Nian's favor"
choices.risk_hint: "Su Qingyao holds grudges, she will definitely seek revenge later"

text.content: "Chen Ji stepped forward, shielding Chen Nian behind him. He raised his head, those usually timid eyes suddenly flickering with sharpness: 'Senior Sister Su, my sister is young and foolish, I'll apologize on her behalf for any rudeness. But...' he paused, 'what she said isn't wrong. The first place in the competition was won before everyone's eyes. If Senior Sister has doubts, you may investigate.' Su Qingyao's pupils slightly contracted—this废物 actually dared to talk back today? The surrounding disciples also whispered among themselves, clearly shocked by Chen Ji's change."

choices.description: "Appease both sides, protect Chen Nian without making Su Qingyao too embarrassed."
choices.visible_cost: "May make Chen Nian think her brother is weak"
choices.risk_hint: "Chen Nian may not understand, pleasing neither side"

text.content: "Chen Ji sighed softly, taking Chen Nian's hand, bowing to Su Qingyao: 'My sister is不懂事, Senior Sister please be magnanimous and don't argue with her. As for this letter...' he smiled wryly, 'honestly, I'm also at a loss. Once I investigate the reason, if convenient, I will truthfully report to Senior Sister.' Su Qingyao narrowed her eyes to examine him for a moment, coldly saying: 'You better remember what you said today.' With that, she swept her sleeve and left, her back conveying three parts anger and seven parts confusion."

"After Su Qingyao left, the surrounding disciples also dispersed while whispering. Fatty Qian leaned close to Chen Ji, lowering his voice: 'Chen Shixiong, what the letter mentioned about dragon veins... that's imperial secret history! How could such a major matter fall on you?' Chen Ji shook his head, his expression confused: 'I also don't understand the reason, perhaps someone mistook me for someone else.' Fatty Qian hesitated, finally just patting his shoulder: 'In any case, be careful. The imperial waters... run very deep.' With that, he hurried away. The noise of the celebration banquet gradually faded, leaving only Chen Ji and Chen Nian standing in the corridor outside the hall. Evening wind brushed past, bringing coolness and a hint of the uncanny."

dialogue.content: "Brother, are you okay?" Chen Nian raised her little face, her clear eyes full of worry, "That Senior Sister Su is so fierce, I don't like her!" Chen Ji rubbed her head, a gentle smile appearing at the corner of his mouth: 'Silly girl, she means no harm. It's just...' he paused, his gaze becoming deep, 'she's too smart, smart enough to give me a headache.' Chen Nian blinked, seeming to understand yet not. Suddenly, she leaned close to Chen Ji's ear, mysteriously saying: 'By the way brother, I think I saw the person who delivered the letter just now!' Chen Ji's whole body shuddered, grabbing her wrist: 'What did you say?'"

text.content: "Chen Nian was startled by her brother's sudden reaction, but still obediently described: 'It was... a person in black robes, very tall, but their face was covered by a hood, couldn't see clearly. When he left, it seemed like he looked back at me...' she tilted her head recalling, 'That gaze was so strange, like he was... looking at something very important.' Chen Ji's alarm bells rang loudly in his heart. According to the Tianji Record Fragment, those who could see through disguises were extremely rare, yet this person dared to deliver a letter right under the Tianqing Sect's nose and then directly look at Chen Nian—what did that mean? His fingers unconsciously stroked the jade pendant left by his father in his sleeve, an ominous feeling rising in his heart."

choice.prompt: "Regarding the imperial letter and the mysterious messenger, what should be the next move?"

choices.description: "Have Chen Nian describe more details, try to use Tianji Record to foresee the messenger's identity and purpose."
choices.visible_cost: "Consumes Heavenly Fate Value, and may alert the target"
choices.visible_reward: "Obtain key intelligence in advance, seize the initiative"
choices.risk_hint: "Foresight images may become blurred due to Chen Nian's presence, more trouble than it's worth"

text.content: "Deep at night, Chen Ji returned to the scripture archive alone. He sat cross-legged, placing the Tianji Record Fragment on his knees, closing his eyes to concentrate. After three breaths, that familiar vast power surged from the fragment, piercing through his soul—however, when he tried to peer into the messenger's identity, his vision was a chaotic blur. 'What's going on?' he frowned, 'Why can't I see clearly?' On the fragment, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul faintly appeared: 'Because she is by your side. The Heavenly Fate lock interferes with heavenly secrets, you cannot foresee anything related to her.' Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, his heart sinking—this girl, how many secrets is she still hiding?"

choices.description: "Since the letter has arrived, might as well face it坦然. Prepare secretly, act according to circumstances."
choices.visible_reward: "Contacting imperial forces may help find father's clues"
choices.risk_hint: "Imperial waters run deep, going rashly may encounter danger"

text.content: "Chen Ji didn't rush to investigate. He took out the imperial letter, unfolding it, examining it carefully under the candlelight. The characters on the letter were ancient and powerful, carrying an aura of great antiquity. And that vermillion seal... his pupils suddenly contracted—this seal's pattern was actually somewhat similar to the pattern on the back cover of the Tianji Record Fragment! 'The dragon veins will stir,望君一行...' he murmured to himself, 'Father, what exactly did you leave behind?' Outside the window, night wind howled, seemingly responding to his questions. The journey to the imperial capital seemed already inevitable."

choices.description: "Ask the remnant soul guardian within the Tianji Record for guidance, to understand the connection between dragon veins and the Tianji Record."
choices.visible_cost: "May trigger new tasks from Mo Xiansheng"
choices.risk_hint: "Mo Xiansheng only says what needs to be said, may leave you more confused after listening"

text.content: "Chen Ji activated the Tianji Record Fragment, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul slowly emerging from the yellowed pages. It was a blurry old man silhouette, surrounded by faint spiritual light. 'Dragon veins?' Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment, his voice hoarse, 'Those are the foundation of the imperial dynasty's founding, and also the place where the Tianji Record was originally sealed.' Chen Ji pressed: 'What connection does it have with my father?' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled slightly,良久才道: 'Your father... was once a candidate for dragon vein guardian.' Before the words finished, the remnant soul sank back into the pages, leaving only silence throughout the room. Chen Ji clenched his fist—his father's secrets ran far deeper than he imagined."

"Night as black as ink, candlelight flickered in the scripture archive. Chen Ji placed the Tianji Record Fragment and the imperial letter side by side on the desk, his brow furrowed tightly. The dragon pattern seal on the letter and the pattern on the fragment's back cover shimmered together, as if narrating some dust-laden history. He closed his eyes, fingertips gently stroking the jade pendant left by his father—the warm touch seemed to contain a faint spiritual consciousness fluctuation. 'The dragon veins will stir,望君一行...' The words from the imperial letter echoed in his mind. North of the imperial capital, atop the clouds. That was the legendary location of the imperial secret archive, and also the burial ground of dragon vein guardians throughout history. Father's death, mother's disappearance, sister's special abilities... all of this seemed to point in the same direction."

dialogue.content: "Brother!" Chen Nian's voice came from outside the door, interrupting Chen Ji's thoughts. She pushed the door open, carrying a bowl of steaming spirit rice porridge, 'It's so late and you still haven't slept, you definitely skipped eating again, right?' Chen Ji opened his eyes, looking at his sister's eager expression, warmth rising in his heart. This girl, clearly she also needed someone to look after her, yet she always thought of him. 'Put it down.' He took the bowl, fingertips touching the warm porcelain, suddenly remembering the earlier foresight—any image involving Chen Nian was blurred. He lowered his head to drink the porridge, hiding his thoughts, yet his heart grew heavier: does this child even know how special she is? What does the Holy Sect want with her by taking her away?"

text.content: "Chen Ji set down the bowl, his gaze falling on the deep night outside the window. The journey to the imperial capital was already inevitable, but he knew in his heart that once he went, there might be no turning back. The secrets of the dragon veins, the complete inheritance of the Tianji Record, father's true cause of death—all the clues pointed to that cloud-capped peak north of the imperial capital. And his seemingly innocent and carefree sister, what role did she play in this grand chess game? The candle flame crackled, casting dancing shadows on the wall. Chen Ji slowly stood, tucking the imperial letter into his chest. The storm rises again, the world will fall into chaos. And he, this废物 disciple in the eyes of the world, would step into this unprecedented chess game with the posture of a chess player. 'Brother, what are you thinking about?' Chen Nian curiously leaned in. 'Nothing.' Chen Ji rubbed her head, a meaningful smile appearing at the corner of his mouth, 'I was just thinking... tomorrow, I should take you out to see the world.'"
